label: Redmi Note 12 smartphone
description: Xiaomi Redmi Note 12 (4G) — 6.67-inch budget phone, Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) and LTE only, no 5G radio; USB-C 2.0.
notes: Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac, 1x1 on the 4G model, 2.4/5 GHz, 80 MHz) — no Wi-Fi 6, no OFDMA, no TWT: it drags airtime on a modern AP and is the right device for capacity tests. Cellular: LTE Cat 13 only, no 5G. USB-C 2.0 with no Ethernet support in MIUI, so no usb0 — wired tethering is not available on this model.
